thread:
Alex: Quick async check — DriveWave quarterly milestone status: what shipped, what slipped, next steps. TL;DR: model-routing MVP shipped to staging and marked feature-complete; autoscale work slipped due to a Dedicated shim bug; infra needs a short capacity bump for canary. Owners: Priya (routing), Marcus (autoscale), Eva (infra).

Priya: Routing MVP is live on staging. Perf looks good overall but p95 regressed on long sequences; filed bug #124. Planning canary tomorrow once infra bump is in. @Alex can you confirm the canary window? :eyes:

Marcus: Autoscale slipped — hit a GRPC connection leak in the Dedicated shim when streams backpressure. Patch up in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — needs review + one unit-test fix. If review + minor fix, ETA +5d.

Eva: Infra note: I'm vetting the PR, one integration test fails on node reclaim (repro steps added in PR). Also we need a temporary capacity bump in us-west to run the routing canary under realistic load — tagging ops.

ops-bot: Capacity request recorded: INF-769. Estimated slot allocation: 4 gpus (us-west) on 2024-03-28 02:00 UTC for a 6h window.

Priya: Thanks — once the bump is up I'll start canary with 10% traffic and monitor error budget. Also there is one remaining CR on routing changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1207 @Marcus @Eva please review.

Marcus: I'll review this afternoon. Quick question: does the routing fallback chain already trigger on OOMs to the smaller quantized variant? I saw a flag but not the rollout policy.

Alex: Yes — fallback is configured in rollout_policy.yml (short snippet):

```
# rollout_policy.yml
fallback:
  on_oom: true
  models: ["drivewave-lite-q4", "drivewave-8bit-v1"]
  max_fallbacks: 2
```
Priya: Perfect. Plan: canary 10% -> 48h monitor window -> full rollout. If autoscale PR stays delayed, we can limit initial rollout to reserved capacity in Dedicated to reduce risk.

Eva: Agreed. Next steps: Marcus to get PR green, Priya to start canary after ops bump, Alex to prepare short rollback playbook (commands + alert triggers). I'll watch infra metrics and surface any failures in #eng-sre. @all please add CR pings if you need faster turnarounds.

Marcus: :thumbsup: tagging infra-eng and will get review ETA by EOD.

Alex: Thanks all — I'll update the OKR doc with: routing = shipped (staging -> canary), autoscale = slipped (+5d). If needed we do a quick async check Friday 10:00am PT.
